verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents a GraphQL Developer API, an API playground and key-gated schema introspection, so the axis applies to this SaaS platform. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, a version scheme, changelogs, or a deprecation policy. The API's existence does not show that it is versioned or that deprecations are governed by a published policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
